summary.zh: 对比各平台互动率、触达与回报，判断内容是否有效
summary.en: Compare engagement, reach and ROI across social platforms

description.zh: 拿到各平台的互动率、触达和回报数据后，算出表现好坏，与基准对比，指出哪个平台值得继续投入。适合想知道发的内容有没有用，或要在几个平台之间分配精力时使用。需要你提供平台数据。
description.en: Turns engagement, reach and ROI numbers into a comparison: which platform performs best, whether posts are working, and how each sits against benchmarks. Use it when you have platform metrics and need a read on them. You supply data.
